hintShowSettingsHandle:
Toggle whether an additional handle is visible on the map, to access the drawer selection directly.

When hidden, you can still access drawer configuration from the Settings screen.
hintSelectDrawers: Add, remove, or rearrange drawer items on the left and right sides of the map.
hintSortableHandle: When enabled, drawer handles can be reordered by dragging. When disabled, the order is locked but handles can still be tapped.
